title: A person's Reference link fails: score is null on an index key
description: Machines on Machines, 2026-11-05: createReferenceLink fails with Type mismatch for Index Key score Expected N Actual NULL on semanticRelationsByObjectSubjectStateKeyAndScore. buildHumanEdgeRow and reference_links._write_edge wrote score null, though catalog.semantic_relation_record defaults it to 1. The fake stores in tests accepted null, so no test caught it. Fixed by writing 1, keeping the row in both score-sorted indexes that readers use.
